scenario_narrative: A hypothetical payer is assessing fragmented data services and the effort needed to support growth.
The planning team would compare cloud patterns,
data governance needs, workload priorities, and transition constraints with business and technology owners.
title: Payer data platform options for growth
case_label: ILLUSTRATIVE SCENARIO — NOT A CLIENT CASE STUDY
validation_summary: Set baseline measures for data access, service reliability, operating effort, and governance adoption. Review evidence with accountable owners before quantifying benefits or choosing a target architecture.
